principle: Verifiable assurance for specific claims in a specific context at a specific time; never a universal trust score.

scope: review/block do not execute in mediator model

globalProofs.tool: TLA+ TLC 2.19 / pinned v1.7.4 tool bundle
scope: hard merchant/beneficiary/amount/currency/freshness/replay bindings are required before verified/approved/executed states
approved/executing/executed requires mandate or observed human approval
payment state alone never grants authority
replay or any hard mismatch cannot execute
execution count never exceeds one in the specified state machine

limitations: model checking proves invariants of the specified/modelled state spaces, not every possible program/environment state
does not prove external-world truth or upstream registry integrity
does not prove arbitrary LLM correctness
does not yet prove every downstream execution adapter is refinement-equivalent to the TLA+ model
does not guarantee zero fraud, merchant fulfilment or financial recovery
A5 requires independent external attestation and is never self-awarded

globalProofs.claim: A machine buyer successfully paid for bounded computation while paymentGrantedAuthority remained false.

capabilities.formalCoverage: production bounded checker plus independent TLA+ state-machine invariants for the high-impact authorization/execution lifecycle
bounded actor/capability/action/scope/active-grant checker plus TLA+ authorization-before-execution invariant
proves: matching active explicit grant exists or does not exist
doesNotProve: that an upstream identity/credential source is uncompromised

proves: observation timestamp satisfies explicit max-age policy
doesNotProve: that fresh information is substantively correct

proves: claims are covered by supplied evidence references
doesNotProve: that a cited source or claim is substantively true

proves: bounded supplied identifiers match under the published scoring rule
doesNotProve: external registry identity unless a verified registry provider is connected

proves: bounded evaluation can be invoked through the provider adapter when configured
doesNotProve: universal correctness of an evaluated output

capabilities.formalCoverage: production bounded checker plus independent TLA+ lifecycle model for merchant/beneficiary/amount/currency/freshness/replay and authorization-before-execution
proves: proposed payment remains exactly bound to supplied merchant/beneficiary/amount/currency intent
expired intent and detected replay block
allow/execution path requires verified mandate or observed human approval
the assurance check itself never executes payment and payment alone never grants authority

nextPromotionGates: bind exact public build SHA into proof registry
buyer adjudication of false positives and false negatives
refinement/equivalence evidence from execution adapters to formal model before broad enforcement
